title: ATLAS: Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival
abstract: arXiv:2611.29152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic survival prediction requires estimates that reflect a patient's observed clinical history. We introduce ATLAS (Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival), a framework that trains a sequence model on longitudinal data and autoregressively samples possible futures conditional on an individual's covariates and observed history. These trajectories form a patient-specific synthetic cohort from which Kaplan-Meier survival curves and Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence curves are estimated. We evaluate ATLAS using two stochastic finite-state automaton benchmarks with exact conditional reference curves: a single-covariate process with duration dependence and a late rule change, and a three-covariate Markov process with recovery and competing causes of death. Comparisons include eight direct survival models, including validation-optimized DRSA and Dynamic-DeepHit and history-aware SurvTRACE adaptations, with each

translated_title: ATLAS：用于生存纵向分析的自回归轨迹
translated_abstract: 动态生存预测需要能够反映患者已观察到的临床病史的估计结果。我们提出了 ATLAS（Autoregressive Trajectories for Longitudinal Analysis of Survival，用于生存纵向分析的自回归轨迹）框架，该框架在纵向数据上训练序列模型，并以个体的协变量和已观察病史为条件，自回归地采样可能的未来轨迹。这些轨迹构成了一个患者特异性的合成队列，可据此估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线和 Aalen-Johansen 累积发生率曲线。我们使用两个具有精确条件参考曲线的随机有限状态自动机基准来评估 ATLAS：一个是具有持续时间依赖性和后期规则变化的单协变量过程，另一个是具有康复和竞争性死因的三协变量马尔可夫过程。比较对象包括八种直接生存模型，其中包括经过验证优化的 DRSA 和 Dynamic-DeepHit，以及具备历史感知能力的 SurvTRACE 改进版本，每种方法……
tldr: ATLAS 提出一个自回归轨迹框架，通过在纵向数据上训练序列模型并按患者的协变量和病史自回归采样未来，构建患者特异性合成队列，从而估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线与 Aalen-Johansen 累积发生率曲线，实现动态生存预测。
en_tdlr: ATLAS is an autoregressive trajectory framework that trains a sequence model on longitudinal data and samples patient-specific synthetic cohorts to estimate Kaplan-Meier survival and Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence curves for dynamic survival prediction.
